name: Typst
description: Code intelligence for Typst documents with tinymist.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Typst files. The language server starts when a Typst file opens in a project and stops when none are open. Tinymist handles Typst documents without a separate Typst installation.
